verdict.rationale: Cerebras offers a Batch API that processes groups of requests asynchronously in the background [cerebras-docs-8]. It also offers tool calling and structured outputs that developers can use to build their own agent loops [cerebras-docs-7, cerebras-docs-6]. However, it is a raw inference API with no first-party automation layer, so any autonomous workflow must be built and hosted by the user. Missing for 10: scheduled or triggered automations, a managed background agent runtime, workflow orchestration, and any hands-on evidence of autonomous automations running on the platform.
